native_retrieval.snippet: # India tunnel collapse kills 22, with others trapped as toxic gases hamper rescue. An explosion in the tunnel, suspected to have been caused by methane trapped in or released from rocks, filled it with dense fumes and toxic gases, trapping 25 people. Rescue team members outside the entrance to an under-construction tunnel at a hydropower project in Samardung, India, on Tuesday.AP. GUWAHATI, India — At least seven more bodies were recovered from the tunnel of an under-construction hydroelectric project in India’s northeastern state of Sikkim, the state government said Thursday, bringing the death toll from a blast to 22. An explosion in the tunnel, suspected to have been caused by methane trapped in or released from rocks, filled it with dense fumes and toxic gases, trapping 25 workers and officials of NHPC. “Rescue operations remain in progress, with specialized teams working in close coordination to locate and recover the remaining victims,” the Sikkim state government said in a Facebook post.

native_retrieval.title: ‘Cockroach’ protests spread across India as leading activist ends hunger strike - NBC News
native_retrieval.snippet: Sonam Wangchuk said he ended his 26-day hunger strike after appeals from lawmakers. An activist has ended his 26-day hunger strike that helped to galvanize India’s youth-led “Cockroach” protests, turning them into one of the most sustained challenges to the country’s leadership in years. But demonstrators vowed Friday to press on despite Sonam Wangchuk’s decision to end his fast, as the protests spread from the capital New Dehli to other cities around the country including Mumbai, Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Ahmedabad. Wangchuk’s fastbegan amid protests about education reforms after alleged leaks in some of the country’s most competitive university entrance exams, but quickly became a lightning rod for public anger over education, economic inequality and the rule of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Wangchuk said in a post on X that he ended his fast after appeals from dozens of members of parliament and following “a long negotiation on various conditions and in view of possible violence in the country.” Conceding that not all his demands were met, he said two federal lawmakers were present when he finished.
